summary: EQT Private Equity Company LLC filed an 8-K to disclose its transactional net asset value per share as of April 30, 2026, used to price share sales and repurchases. The filing lists per share values for multiple share classes, ranging from $28.15 to $30.24, with no outstanding shares for certain classes. There is no transaction, merger, tender, or other special situation. The filing is a routine NAV disclosure for an investment fund, not an extraordinary corporate event.
